records.title: Industrial Parks in Telangana
details: It was inter-alia stated that under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme, the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) chaired by the Hon'ble Prime Minister has approved development of Zaheerabad Industrial area in Telangana as part of 12 new industrial project proposals under the National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP) on 28th August, 2024. Ministry of Food Processing Industries under Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY) has approved 68 projects for food processing industries in Telangana state with a total project cost of Rs. 1849.12 crores. Out of these, 32 projects have been completed. Ministry of Textiles is setting up 7 (seven) PM Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel (PM, MITRA) Parks in Greenfield/Brownfield sites with world class infrastructure including plug and play facility with an outlay of Rs. 4445 cr for a period of seven years upto 2027-28.
